race.comment: TREBILCO (5) resumed with a tidy win in a Class 2 at Morphettville over 1200m. He looks to have come back well and the rise to 1400m second up is perfect. He'll land in a handy spot from the inside gate and take plenty of beating. LUNAMAN (7) resumes. He comes to the Maher yard from New Zealand having last run in a G3 at Ellerslie. He'll be better over further but has won this trip and warrants respect. UNTAPPED (2) doesn't win out of turn but is racing consistently and looks an each way chance back in grade. GRIFTER (10) is lightly raced having scored his maiden two back then ran well at Geelong. Can improve again and figure in the finish. EMPRESSIVE ENUFF (8) next best.
